title: 魚
teacherNotes: Release integration for L212. Latest origin/main is being advanced in playable order, with R011/R012 and all prior lessons integrated before this unit, so there are no unresolved provisional learned characters. Production owns the asset-complete lesson-local package; Release owns production JSON, planner, ledger, registry cleanup, final verify, merge, and deploy.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: latest origin/main production JSON through L211 plus current target from newChars
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
Use L058 lesson images only as illustration style references; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Use protagonist family identity anchors from L154/L162/L163 when the sentence shows the protagonist girl, protagonist mother, or protagonist father.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brands, boat names, dish labels, aquarium labels, license plates, or readable marks.
Each image must clearly match its approved image notes and remain phone-readable in a square crop.

Human roles must be explicitly distinguished: protagonist little girl, protagonist father, protagonist mother, and distant passerby boat crew or sea worker must not share one face or be copied from L058.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate G02 prefix/suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 海水裡有很多小魚，畫面重點是海裡成群的小魚，水面與海水環境清楚。不可有文字、數字、標籤、水族箱牌子或水印。
主角小女孩在船上看見水裡的大魚，旁邊可有主角爸爸陪同以表現安全。主角小女孩外觀依 L154/L162/L163 continuity：粉紅外套、白上衣、藍裙、粉紅鞋、小粉紅髮夾；主角爸爸為藍襯衫或外套、白上衣、卡其褲。L058 只作畫風參考，不複製人物長相。不可有文字、數字、船名、標籤或水印。
晚上家裡餐桌旁，主角爸爸把一盤魚料理給主角小女孩吃，畫面溫和生活化，不要血腥或處理生魚。主角爸爸為藍襯衫或外套、白上衣、卡其褲；主角小女孩為粉紅外套、白上衣、藍裙、粉紅鞋、小粉紅髮夾。外觀依 L154/L162/L163 continuity；L058 只作畫風參考，不複製人物長相。不可有文字、數字、餐具標籤或水印。
主角媽媽提醒主角小女孩早點把小魚放回水裡，主角小女孩小心把魚放進清水中，畫面要安全溫柔。主角媽媽為白或米色上衣、寬藍褲、肩長深色髮；主角小女孩為粉紅外套、白上衣、藍裙、粉紅鞋、小粉紅髮夾。外觀依 L154/L162/L163 continuity；L058 只作畫風參考，不複製人物長相。不可有文字、數字、標籤或水印。
晚上，一艘小船開進海裡，畫面要有夜色、海面和小船前進方向。若有人物出現，只能是遠處船上路人船員或海上工作者，不可畫成主角家庭；人物要很小且安全，並與主角媽媽、爸爸、小女孩明顯不同。不可有文字、數字、船名、標籤或水印。

G01.reason: 「很多小魚」是本課核心圖像用法，目標字清楚。
